scripts.android:doctor: sh -c 'SDK=${ANDROID_HOME:-$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}; test -n "$SDK" && test -d "$SDK" || { echo "Android SDK not found. Set ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT." >&2; exit 1; }; echo "Android SDK: $SDK"'
scripts.ios:debug: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Turna.xcworkspace -scheme Turna -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build
scripts.ios:release: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Turna.xcworkspace -scheme Turna -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
